description: NUREG-1437 is the NRC staff's Generic Environmental Impact Statement (GEIS) for License Renewal of Nuclear Plants, a reference document that assesses environmental issues common to the licence renewal of operating nuclear power plants under NEPA. The publication page lists Volume 1 (main report, sections 1 to 10) with an addendum on transportation and the summary table of findings on NEPA issues, Volume 2 (appendices), the Revision 1 and Revision 2 final reports, and a long series of plant-specific supplements, for example Calvert Cliffs, Oconee, Turkey Point (second renewal), Surry, North Anna, McGuire, Peach Bottom, Point Beach and others. Coverage is United States commercial nuclear plants. Access: PDF downloads on the NRC site, free; no licence statement was on the page. Caveats: the page is an index, so individual volumes were not read. It suits environmental and regulatory analysis of nuclear plant life extension, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
